args.rationale: The trigger recommended buying 800 units of SKU-1003. Simulation shows that ordering 800 units is infeasible because it violates storage capacity (peak occupancy 204.00 m³ vs 200.00 m³ limit) and the excess cover limit (29.4 days vs 12 days). Current usable inventory is 176 units against a 28-day demand forecast of 476 units (17 units/day). Without new supply, stockout begins on 2026-09-27 resulting in 300 unmet units. Supplier SUP-A offers a 7-day lead time at $13.00/unit, MOQ 250, pack size 50. Ordering 500 units arriving 2026-09-24 reduces unmet demand to 0 units, keeps peak occupancy within capacity at 198.00 m³, and leaves closing inventory at 200 units (11.8 days of cover, within policy). Total spend is $6,500.00, which exceeds the $2,000.00 autonomy limit and requires buyer approval.
